subject.title: [Bug]: In msteams channel messages, OpenClaw can't access inbound attachments

question: Should the Microsoft Teams Graph media fallback for non-personal HTML activities land as an automatic behavior change, a default-off `channels.msteams.graphMediaFallback` option, or a combined channel-plus-group repair with a single policy?
rationale: Current main avoids noisy Graph lookups by requiring extracted attachment ids, but live evidence shows Teams can omit those ids for real uploaded files; the chosen default affects Graph call volume, permissions expectations, diagnostics, and existing deployments.

options.title: Combine fixes with default-off fallback
options.body: Adopt the channel URL/thread fixes and the group-chat fallback behind an explicit opt-in so existing installs keep the mention-only protection unless operators enable extra Graph reads.

options.title: Land channel fix first
options.body: Merge the channel aadGroupId/reply URL repair now and leave group-chat default policy to the separate config PR.

options.title: Make fallback automatic
options.body: Relax the fallback for all non-personal HTML activities with no media, accepting extra Graph reads and the risk of renewed mention-only noise.

recommendation.title: Combine fixes with default-off fallback
recommendation.body: Adopt the channel URL/thread fixes and the group-chat fallback behind an explicit opt-in so existing installs keep the mention-only protection unless operators enable extra Graph reads.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows the strongest merged ownership signal across msteams media/channel delivery and the remaining choice is a compatibility-sensitive product default.
